items.raw_excerpt: GWS captain Toby Greene admits he "couldn't give a f*** about facilities" as he prepares to meet Geelong about a potential move to the Cats.
items.summary_en: GWS captain Toby Greene says he does not care about club facilities. He is preparing to meet Geelong about a possible move to the Cats.
items.summary_ko: GWS 주장 토비 그린이 구단 시설에는 관심이 없다고 말했다. 그는 지롱 캣츠로의 이적을 놓고 지롱 구단과 만날 준비를 하고 있다.
items.title_en: Giants star Toby Greene opens up on his AFL future
items.title_ko: 자이언츠 스타 토비 그린, AFL 거취에 심경 고백
items.title_original: Giants star Toby Greene opens up on his AFL future
